summary: Website for True Origin Company LLP, a food products company dealing in perishable and non-perishable food products. The site showcases moringa powder, moringa leaf, moringa farm, curry leaves farm, okra farm, and farm imagery. Contact emails updated to info@trueoriginexports.com and sales@trueoriginexports.com (replacing trueorigin@gmail.com). Phone: 9773303026. The site positions the company as professional exporters with export/cargo imagery. A social media video section placeholder is present, with plans to add Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, and Facebook links later. The company logo is displayed in the navigation bar. Multi-language support is implemented with a language selector in the top-right corner. The company website URL www.trueoriginintl.com is included. SSL is to be enabled. New pages to be added: Privacy Policy, Terms and Conditions, and a detailed Export Certification/Quality Control/Product Specifications page.
architectural_notes: Static/marketing website for a food products company (perishable and non-perishable goods)
Social media links (Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, Facebook) to be added when URLs are provided
Multi-language support required: all content translatable by user preference except company name 'True Origin Company LLP'; language selector in top-right corner of header
Contact emails updated to info@trueoriginexports.com and sales@trueoriginexports.com; SSL to be enabled
New static pages required: Privacy Policy, Terms & Conditions, Export Certification/Quality Control/Product Specifications

existing_features.title: Create a multi-section landing page for True Origin Company LLP, including: a hero section with company name and tagline, an 'About Us' section describing the business (dealing in perishable and non-perishable food products), a 'Products' section showcasing key offerings, and a 'Contact' section with placeholder contact details.

Render the generated images (moringa-powder.png, moringa-leaf.png, farm.png, hero-bg.png) as static assets from frontend/public/assets/generated. Use the farm image as the hero background, moringa powder and moringa leaf images in the Products section, and the hero-bg as a decorative or supplemental background element.

Apply a cohesive earthy-green and warm-cream visual theme throughout the website. Use natural, organic-feeling typography (e.g., a serif display font for headings paired with a clean sans-serif for body text). The layout should feel clean, trustworthy, and premium — appropriate for a natural food products brand. Apply this theme consistently across all sections, cards, buttons, and the navigation bar.
Remove the 'Moringa Tablet' product card from the Products section entirely.
Remove the 'Moringa Seed Oil' product card from the Products section.
Remove any 'years of experience' stat or claim from the About section (or anywhere else on the page). The company has just started, so no experience duration should be displayed.
Update the Contact section with the real company contact details: phone number 9773303026 and email trueorigin@gmail.com. Replace any placeholder values.

Add a dedicated 'Social Media' section (or clearly marked subsection) to the page as a placeholder for social media videos. The section should display a visually styled empty state with a heading such as 'Follow Us' or 'Our Latest Updates', placeholder video embed slots (e.g., 2–3 placeholder cards with a play icon and label), and a note that links are coming soon. Include empty/disabled icon slots for Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, and Facebook so URLs can be wired up in a future update.

Add an 'Export & Cargo' visual section (or subsection within About/Products) that features the generated export and cargo images to communicate that True Origin Company LLP is a professional exporter. The section should include a short heading such as 'Global Exports' and brief supporting copy about the company's export capabilities.

Add the uploaded True Origin Exports logo (to be saved as frontend/public/assets/generated/logo.png) to the navigation bar. Display it on the left side of the nav, replacing or accompanying the current text-based brand name. The logo should be appropriately sized for a navigation bar (height ~40–48px) and must be visible against the nav background on both scroll states (transparent and solid).

Create a language selection context/provider that stores the user's chosen language and exposes a translation function. Support at least English, Hindi, and one additional regionally relevant language (e.g., Marathi or Gujarati). All translatable strings across the site must be defined in a centralized translations file keyed by language code. The company name 'True Origin Company LLP' must never be translated and must remain in English in all language modes.

Add a language selector UI control to the right-hand side of the navigation bar. The control should display the currently selected language (e.g., 'EN', 'HI') and open a dropdown listing the available languages. Selecting a language immediately applies the translation site-wide. The control must be visible and functional in both the transparent (top of page) and solid (scrolled) nav states, and must also be accessible in the mobile nav menu.

Translate all user-facing text in every section and component — HeroSection, AboutSection, ProductsSection, ExportCargoSection, SocialMediaSection, ContactSection, Footer, and nav links — using the centralized translations system. Each component must consume the language context to render its strings. Static image alt text should also be translated where applicable.

Add the company website URL 'www.trueoriginintl.com' as a clickable hyperlink (href='https://www.trueoriginintl.com') in the Footer component alongside the existing contact details (phone and email). Also display it in the ContactSection's contact info panel. The URL must be translated as a label (e.g., 'Website:') using the centralized translations system for English, Hindi, and Marathi, while the URL value itself remains unchanged across all languages.

Add three new farm/product images — moringa farm, curry leaves farm, and okra farm — as static assets at frontend/public/assets/generated/ (filenames: moringa-farm.png, curry-leaves-farm.png, okra-farm.png). Display these images on the website, either within the Products section as contextual farm imagery for the respective products or in a dedicated 'Our Farms' visual subsection. All image alt text must use the centralized translations system.

Update the ContactSection component and Footer component to replace the existing email address(es) with two email addresses: info@trueoriginexports.com and sales@trueoriginexports.com. Both emails must be displayed as clickable mailto: links. The email label and these two addresses must also be added to the centralized translations file for English, Hindi, and Marathi (the address values themselves must remain unchanged across languages).

Create a Privacy Policy page as a new React route/component (e.g., /privacy-policy). The page must follow the existing earthy-green and warm-cream visual theme, include the site navigation bar and footer, and contain comprehensive privacy policy content covering: data collection practices, use of personal information, cookies policy, third-party services, user rights, contact information for privacy inquiries (info@trueoriginexports.com), and the effective date. All user-facing text must be integrated with the centralized translations system for English, Hindi, and Marathi. Add a link to the Privacy Policy page in the footer.

Create a Terms and Conditions page as a new React route/component (e.g., /terms-and-conditions). The page must follow the existing earthy-green and warm-cream visual theme, include the site navigation bar and footer, and contain comprehensive terms and conditions content covering: acceptance of terms, use of the website, intellectual property, product information disclaimer, limitation of liability, governing law, dispute resolution, and contact information (info@trueoriginexports.com). All user-facing text must be integrated with the centralized translations system for English, Hindi, and Marathi. Add a link to the Terms and Conditions page in the footer.

Create an Export Certification, Quality Control & Product Specifications page as a new React route/component (e.g., /export-certification). The page must follow the existing earthy-green and warm-cream visual theme, include the site navigation bar and footer, and contain detailed content organized into three sections: (1) Export Certifications — covering types of certifications obtained or pursued (e.g., APEDA, FSSAI, Phytosanitary Certificate, Certificate of Origin, HACCP), their purpose, and how they assure buyers; (2) Quality Control — covering sourcing standards, inspection processes, packaging and storage protocols, and traceability; (3) Product Specifications — detailed spec tables or cards for each product (Moringa Powder, Moringa Leaf/Dried, Curry Leaves, Okra/Lady Finger) including scientific name, form, color, moisture content, packaging options, shelf life, and available grades. All user-facing text must be integrated with the centralized translations system for English, Hindi, and Marathi. Add a link to this page in the footer and optionally in the navigation bar.

Set up client-side routing (e.g., using React Router) in the application to support the new pages: Privacy Policy (/privacy-policy), Terms and Conditions (/terms-and-conditions), and Export Certification (/export-certification). The main landing page must remain the default route (/). The navigation bar and footer links to these pages must use the router's Link component for in-app navigation without full page reloads.
